scope: Source-only smoke tests on a clean snapshot reconstructed from the two checksum-verified archives published to this repository, plus their server-side receipts and existing LICENSE. No historical output binaries or cached motor geometry were copied into this snapshot.
command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_core.py tests/test_drawings_media.py tests_legacy -k 'not individual_motor_parts'
excluded_check: test_no_missing_individual_motor_parts; requires the full motor catalogue and motor geometry build
limitations: This is a local clean-snapshot test run, not a claim of full-suite CI, full historical binary publication, mechanical contact simulation or engineering qualification. VTK deprecated API warnings remain.
